description: This file defines types, function prototypes, and macros related to collecting and executing functions across multiple worker threads or contexts in the lighttpd server. It declares callback function types, a data structure for collection information, and functions to start and manage collection activities.

methods.name: li_collect_start
methods.description: Starts a collection of a function across worker contexts and returns a pointer to collection info; may call the callback directly if only one worker or context.

methods.name: li_collect_start_global
methods.description: Starts a global collection using the main server worker, never returns directly, and manages the collection across all worker contexts.

methods.name: li_collect_break
methods.description: Interrupts an ongoing collection, causing the callback to be invoked with 'complete' set to FALSE.

ctags.name: liCollectCB

ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(liWorker * wrk,gpointer cbdata,gpointer fdata,GPtrArray * result,gboolean complete)
